players.product: NULISA precision-proteomics assays and ARGO HT System

quarterly_data.signal: Prospectus customer concentration: no customer represented 10% or more of total revenue in 2024 or 2025 (one customer represented 10% or more of net accounts receivable); a majority of revenue in both years came from research and academic institutions. Approximately 42% (2024) and 38% (2025) of revenue came from customers outside North America. Alamar sells directly in North America, Europe and China and through distributor partnerships in Australia, portions of Eastern Europe, India, Japan, Singapore and South Korea.
quarterly_data.figure: no customer 10% or more of 2024 or 2025 revenue; 38% of 2025 revenue outside North America

quarterly_data.signal: Prospectus commercial collaborations: the German Center for Neurodegenerative Diseases (DZNE) is running 23,000 samples from the Rhineland study using the CNS Disease Panel and the Inflammation panel; the Global Neurodegeneration Proteomics Consortium (GNPC), funded in part by Gates Ventures and the Alzheimer's Disease Data Initiative, plans to characterize roughly 40,000 plasma samples with the NULISA CNS Disease and Inflammation panels and will fund the set-up of high-throughput ARGO HT facilities in India, Sweden, the UK and the US; the Michael J. Fox Foundation funds multiple projects to develop ultra-sensitive Parkinson's disease biomarker assays on the platform. The NULISAqpcr Alzheimer's Disease 5plex panel (BD-pTau217, NfL, Abeta42, GFAP and APOE4 in one automated assay) launched in March 2026.
quarterly_data.figure: DZNE 23,000 samples; GNPC roughly 40,000 plasma samples; AD 5plex launched March 2026
